exact_observation_replay.scope: Baseline and current implementation replay the baseline full11game trace, then optimized implementation replays its own full11game trace; every actual state compares full observations, legal menus, planning keys, actor/kind, action features and state+executionRNG.

weights_transfer.purpose: inference-only transfer into fresh current-rule environments; not a training resume

operation_profiles.scope: Repeated unchanged root with warmed caches; cloned transitions change their copied state. Operation timers overlap, particularly inference includes feature assembly; do not add them.

serial_search_after.cache_scope: Root features warmed by three operation-profile repeats; descendants first-use
serial_search_after.note: Serial cProfile timings include profiler overhead and are not batched throughput estimates
serial_search_after.profile_accounting_note: Compare recorded self-time with search wall time before attributing costs. If they differ materially, profiler rows are partial diagnostics; use the separate operation wall timers rather than percentages of total search.

limitations: Sampled aggregate RSS is resident RAM usage; shared pages may be counted more than once. Sampling does not enforce an instantaneous kernel allocation cap.

resource_accounting.memory_monitor_scope: Supervisor plus one worker, sampled every0.1s with128MiB safety margin; search uses threads, no worker subprocesses.

verification.limitation: One paired invocation per configuration on one machine. This is evidence of operational speed/correctness, not confidence intervals or useful learned strategy.

neural_tolerance.scope: Only priors and value estimates; action identity/order/features, visit counts, visit-derived policy and actual state/RNG must agree exactly.
